test_title: SSC CGL 2023 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 18 Jul 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: F is C’s son. C is the only daughter of B. D is A’s only son-in-law. B is C’s father. A is B's wife. How is D related to F?
solution:
Preparing the family tree diagram by using the following symbol:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9df47de50d23477d9584a7739f76cb158d8ffb2c289797a4da8278a20e0a1f5a.png] 

As per the given information:

1. F is C’s son and C is the only daughter of B.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4dce7834e6bcbe6c09f902fd71ff61e4fce7d531aaae6f249d7ca4c2d32e3a8e.png] 

2. B is C’s father and A is B's wife.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e73e696ea8fa473c160371dcd802e286c4a29f0342ab3f07b46581637d3c05e0.png] 

3. D is A’s only son-in-law.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f4d3b7073d4c7ac2db2b4b5ac6607cf7cacd04bacce6d3555545ffde0d8715bd.png] 

Here, D is the** father** of F.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option (2)".
